title: Huawei unveils HarmonyOS-powered Qinyun HM650 series desktop PCs for enterprise and government users, saying they use "100% domestically made" components (Iris Deng/South China Morning Post)
summary: Iris Deng / South China Morning Post: Huawei unveils HarmonyOS-powered Qinyun HM650 series desktop PCs for enterprise and government users, saying they use “100% domestically made” components — Huawei Technologies has launched its first desktop computer powered by its proprietary operating system, HarmonyOS …
